name: GitHub CLI
summary: Repository and pull-request operations from the command line.
evidence: Authenticated API reads and source publication passed through an approved background credential route.
limit: Authentication scope still determines which repositories are accessible.
short: Repository work from the command line.

name: ripgrep
summary: Find the relevant source before reading the whole repository.
evidence: Used for targeted source and configuration searches throughout the setup.
limit: Search results are evidence to inspect, not a substitute for understanding callers.

name: MobileBuildMCP
summary: Build and test Apple apps without driving the editor.
evidence: A generated macOS fixture compiled successfully and its executable ran.
limit: A build does not establish UI correctness, signing readiness or physical-device behavior.

name: Xcode MCP
summary: Connect an external agent to Xcode's editor capabilities.
evidence: A live MCP handshake and tool discovery succeeded with Xcode running.
limit: Connection verified; each project operation still needs its own evidence.

name: SwiftFormat
summary: Check Swift formatting against the project's own conventions.
evidence: Lint mode passed against a small Swift fixture without changing files.
limit: Preserve existing configuration and version pins. Avoid unrelated reformatting.

name: SwiftLint
summary: Run focused Swift source checks alongside native tests.
evidence: A real Swift lint check passed in the native fixture workflow.
limit: Linting complements compiler, behavior and accessibility checks.

name: Peekaboo
summary: Inspect a native interface when an API cannot answer the question.
evidence: Permission status and an app-scoped native window query passed.
limit: macOS permissions are separate gates. A window query does not verify every input action.

name: App Store Connect CLI
summary: Make App Store Connect work scriptable and inspectable.
evidence: A read-only app-list API request passed with an existing protected API key.
limit: No submission or release operation was tested or authorized by setup.

name: Playwright CLI
summary: Check web flows in an isolated headless browser.
evidence: A named session completed a DOM interaction and assertion, then closed.
limit: Web checks cannot validate SwiftUI or AppKit behavior.

name: Chrome DevTools MCP
summary: Inspect browser console, network traffic and performance.
evidence: Configured in the development environment; this journal does not claim a completed performance diagnosis.
limit: Prefer isolated sessions. Access to personal tabs needs a specific task reason.

name: XcodeGen
summary: Generate an Xcode project from a readable specification.
evidence: Generated the native fixture used in a successful background build.
limit: Useful for existing specifications and new projects; not a reason to migrate a working project.

name: fastlane
summary: Reuse established signing, packaging and release lanes.
evidence: Installation and version were checked; release lanes were not executed.
limit: Preserve locked dependencies and existing publication authorization.

name: Gitleaks
summary: Catch accidental credentials before expensive validation begins.
evidence: Rejected a synthetic token, redacted its value, and passed a clean-source scan.
limit: Review findings carefully. Never use blanket exclusions to hide real secrets.

name: Ruff
summary: Catch serious errors in the Python files a commit changed.
evidence: Caught an undefined name; unchanged and deleted Python files were excluded correctly.
limit: The starter check is targeted and error-only. It does not replace tests or impose formatting.

name: Blender
summary: Use local GPU rendering for editable 3D and animation assets.
evidence: A small Cycles render completed in background mode using Apple Metal.
limit: A smoke render is not proof of production art quality or every scene's compatibility.

name: HyperFrames
summary: Author editable motion graphics using web technologies.
evidence: The CLI was available. No completed film render is claimed by this setup journal.
limit: Follow its composition, preview and rendered-review workflow for each real film.

name: FFmpeg
summary: Assemble media and encode final delivery files locally.
evidence: A short H.264 encode succeeded through Apple's VideoToolbox encoder.
limit: Check codec, dimensions, color, timing and audio on each actual export.

name: ImageMagick
summary: Automate image variants, compositing and format conversion.
evidence: Already installed; no production cover-art result is implied.
limit: Keep editable sources and inspect actual dimensions, alpha and appearance.

name: resvg
summary: Render editable vector artwork to predictable image exports.
evidence: An SVG exported to a PNG with the expected dimensions.
limit: Static SVG rendering does not animate a design or evaluate its visual quality.

name: Gifski
summary: Turn rendered frames into animated previews.
evidence: A GIF export completed and its output format was checked.
limit: Use suitable video formats for final delivery when GIF is not appropriate.

name: Krita
summary: Paint layered artwork and export images or animation sequences.
evidence: Official command-line export documentation was reviewed; not installed in this study.
limit: Useful for image editing; do not assume unattended authoring from export support alone.

name: ComfyUI
summary: Build repeatable local image-generation workflows.
evidence: Apple Silicon and local API support were researched; no model was downloaded or tested.
limit: Model storage, memory, licenses and optional paid API nodes need explicit choices.
